programme.title: White Apache
programme.desc: Outlaws attack a band of settlers and kill everyone except a pregnant woman who's rescued by a band of Indians. The woman dies giving birth but Chief White Bear adopts her male baby, naming him "Shining Sky," and raising him as brother to his own son, Black Wolf.

programme.title: I Am Sartana, Your Angel of Death
programme.desc: A bank that was thought to be impenetrable is robbed by a man wearing the trademark Sartana cloak. Our black-clad hero soon has a price on his head and must try to proof his innocence with the help of his shabby friend Buddy Ben.

programme.title: Two Faces of the Dollar
programme.desc: A teacher, a hero, an ex-colonel, and a beautiful woman plan to rob Fort Henderson. Though the heist succeeds, their troubles have only just begun, as greed, betrayal, and danger threaten to unravel their carefully laid plan.

programme.title: The Counterfeit Kid
programme.desc: Jack, a farmhand, accidentally impersonates the notorious outlaw "Bloody" Ben Harris. Now, on a treasure hunt, he must rely on a group of wild misfits to outsmart the outlaw he's pretending to be. With Harris hot on his trail, Jack must find the treasure and return to his true love, Olivia, before it’s too late.

programme.title: California
programme.desc: After the Civil War, Michael "California" Random, is released from prison and goes to Missouri with his partner William.

programme.title: Paid in Blood
programme.desc: Jeff Cameron is Tom Carter and he’s a man on a mission to get revenge for his brother Jerry, who was gunned down after pulling his life savings out of the Rio Canyon town bank.

programme.title: Heads or Tails
programme.desc: Shanda is charged with the murder of the banker, Burton and to save her from being lynched, the sheriff sends her off to Phoenix. During the trip the two deputies to whom she’s been entrusted rape and leave her in the desert, certain that she’s dead. The girl is found by Black Talisman, an outlaw, who takes her to his hideout, nurses her back to health and after hearing her story, determines to avenge her and clear her name.

programme.title: Troublemakers
programme.desc: Two brothers who hate each other are going to spend Christmas with their mother. She tries to get them together.

programme.title: Quinto: Fighting Proud
programme.desc: After a bank heist, a gang of outlaws convenes at a desert saloon, only to find the loot missing. Suspicion and paranoia spiral out of control, leading them to turn on each other in a deadly struggle for survival.

programme.title: A Coffin for the Sheriff
programme.desc: Spaghetti Western icon Anthony Steffen stars as Shenandoah, a mysterious man who joins a ruthless band of highwaymen after overcoming an almost impossible and death-defying initiation.

programme.title: Taste of Killing
programme.desc: Dubious Bounty Killer Hank Fellows tracks bank stage coaches to observe them being robbed.

programme.title: Kill Django... Kill First
programme.desc: Johnny MaGee arrives in a mining town and clashes with banker Anthony Burton, who uses underhanded tactics to acquire gold mines. As Burton manipulates the locals, including offering to wipe out a doctor’s debts in exchange for his sister’s marriage, Johnny finds an ally in bounty hunter Ted. But Burton’s reach goes far beyond the mines.

programme.title: Django Kill... If You Live, Shoot!
programme.desc: Various factions, feud over stolen gold in a surreal town.

programme.title: Black Tigress
programme.desc: Lola, a saloon dancer, arrives in Sant'Anna, a town terrorized by outlaw El Diablo, who aims to sell the land to a railroad. With the help of Rod, a young admirer, Lola inspires the townspeople to rise up and fight for their land.

programme.title: Murieta!
programme.desc: The story of Joaquin Murrieta, a real life Mexican bandit who terrorized California with his gang of raiders and cutthroats during the first half of the 19th century. Some saw him as a murderous outlaw, others as the Mexican Robin Hood.
